arbeidsmiljoloven.title: Working Environment Act (arbeidsmiljøloven)
arbeidsmiljoloven.description: Requirements for a safe and healthy working environment, working hours and employee involvement.

duties.d1: Assess the risks in the working environment and follow up with an action plan.
duties.d2: Have a safety representative, and a working environment committee when there are 50 or more employees.
duties.d3: Register and follow up injuries and accidents.
duties.d4: Keep records of working hours and overtime.

internkontrollforskriften.title: Internal Control Regulations (internkontrollforskriften)
internkontrollforskriften.description: Systematic health, safety and environment work: goals, responsibilities, risk assessment and an annual review.

duties.d1: Set written goals for health, safety and the environment.
duties.d2: Describe how HSE work is organised and who is responsible for what.
duties.d3: Identify hazards, assess the risk and make plans to reduce it.
duties.d4: Monitor and review the internal control at least once a year.

personopplysningsloven.title: Personal Data Act and GDPR (personopplysningsloven)
personopplysningsloven.description: Rules for processing personal data, in force in Norway through the Personal Data Act.

duties.d1: Keep a record of processing activities (Art. 30).
duties.d2: Have a lawful basis for each processing and inform the people concerned (Art. 6 and 13).
duties.d3: Answer requests from data subjects within one month (Art. 12).
duties.d4: Report personal data breaches to the Data Protection Authority within 72 hours (Art. 33).
duties.d5: Have data processing agreements with all processors (Art. 28).

forurensningsloven.title: Discharge permit under the Pollution Control Act
forurensningsloven.description: A permit that sets limits for discharges and requires measurement and annual reporting.

duties.d1: Keep discharges within the limits set in the permit.
duties.d2: Measure discharges as the permit's measurement programme requires.
duties.d3: Report annual discharges to the authority by the deadline.

brannvernloven.title: Fire and Explosion Protection Act (brann- og eksplosjonsvernloven)
brannvernloven.issuer: Norwegian Directorate for Civil Protection (DSB) and the local fire service
brannvernloven.description: Duties to prevent fire and explosions and to be prepared if they happen.

duties.d1: Check and maintain fire safety equipment.
duties.d2: Hold fire drills and train employees.
duties.d3: Store hazardous substances safely and keep the register of them up to date.

apenhetsloven.title: Transparency Act (åpenhetsloven)
apenhetsloven.description: Larger companies must carry out due diligence for human rights and decent working conditions in the supply chain.

duties.d1: Carry out due diligence assessments of suppliers and business partners.
duties.d2: Publish an account of the due diligence by 30 June each year.
duties.d3: Answer requests for information within three weeks.

bokforingsloven.title: Bookkeeping Act (bokføringsloven)
bokforingsloven.description: Requirements for bookkeeping, documentation and how long accounting records are kept.

duties.d1: Record transactions on time with proper documentation.
duties.d2: Keep the primary accounting records for five years.

digitalsikkerhetsloven.title: Digital Security Act (digitalsikkerhetsloven)
digitalsikkerhetsloven.description: Security requirements for providers of essential and digital services. It implements the NIS directive; NIS2 is expected to follow.

duties.d1: Take appropriate technical and organisational security measures.
duties.d2: Report serious incidents to the authority without undue delay.
duties.d3: Make sure management follows up and is trained in the security work.

ki_forordningen.title: EU AI Act: duties as a deployer of AI systems
ki_forordningen.issuer: EU (the national supervisory authority is to be appointed)
ki_forordningen.description: Duties for organisations that use AI systems, especially high-risk systems.

duties.d1: Make sure the people who use AI systems have sufficient AI literacy (Art. 4).
duties.d2: Use high-risk AI systems according to the instructions, with human oversight and monitoring (Art. 26).
duties.d3: Tell people when they interact with AI or see AI-generated content (Art. 50).

sentence.non_compliant: Not compliant – the latest evaluation found that the requirements are not met.
sentence.not_evaluated: Not evaluated yet – we do not know whether we meet the requirements until the first evaluation is recorded.
sentence.not_applicable: Not relevant – the latest evaluation concluded that the obligation does not apply to us now.
sentence.draft: Draft – the obligation is not evaluated until it is made active.
sentence.retired: Retired – the obligation is no longer evaluated, but its history is kept.
